title: Search Media Files: Index PDF, Office and Text Documents | Orchard Core
description:
Files attached to a content item, such as a PDF or a Word document, hold words that site search does not see. A search for a word that only a file contains finds nothing.

The Media Indexing features read the text of PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text and Markdown files and add it to the search index. You enable the features, include a Media Field in the index, update the index, and the content item is found by the words of its files.

In this video:
• How media indexing works, and what must be in place
• Enable the PDF, Text and OpenXML Media Indexing features
• Include a Media Field in the index
• Attach a PDF to an article and publish it
• Reset the index and choose the fields to query
• Search the site for a word that only the PDF holds
• Formats and file types to keep in mind
